name: Check the branch against main
description: Seeded default. Asks the agent to compare the current branch with the main branch and bring in its newer commits.

action.text: At the start of the session, compare the branch you are working on with the repository's main branch: main, master or prod, whichever exists (git symbolic-ref refs/remotes/origin/HEAD names the default). Run git fetch, find which of the two has the most recent commits, and list the commits of the main branch your branch does not contain (git log HEAD..origin/<main> --oneline). If there are any, pull them into your branch unless the work tree is dirty or the merge would conflict, then tell me what came in and whether it touches the files in the scope of this work. Never discard local changes or rewrite history; ask me first when unsure.
